tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalogue. Use broad keywords first (e.g., "shoes" not "red nike running shoes"). If total_matched is high, use filters or add keywords. Always use this to find SKUs before calling get_product.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve deep details, exact stock availability, and variations for a specific product using its SKU.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The category tree. Use this first to learn the exact vocabulary and IDs this store uses before searching.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: The brands this store carries. Use this first to learn valid brand IDs before filtering search_products by brand_ids.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_products" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
